# Contributor License Agreement (CLA)

Thank you for your interest in contributing to arkos-core. This Contributor License Agreement (“Agreement”) clarifies the rights granted by contributors to Nathaniel Morgan and any entity he designates as the arkos project owner (the “Owner”).

---

## Statement of Intent (Non-Binding)

arkos-core is developed as an open-source project with a sustainable long-term model. To be explicit from the beginning:

- **Yes, we retain the right to run a paid hosted service.** We operate a paid hosted service to lower the barrier to entry for users who value arkos-core’s architecture but cannot or do not want to manage GPUs, deployment, upgrades, and uptime themselves. Providing a hosted option allows us to sustain active development, maintenance, and support of the project, while preserving full freedom for anyone to self-host arkos-core and without closing or restricting the open-source core.

- **No, we will not close the open-source core.** The core arkos-core codebase will remain open source, allowing users and contributors to inspect, modify, and run the software independently of any hosted offering.

- **Yes, you can self-host arkos-core indefinitely.** arkos-core may always be self-hosted and run on user-controlled infrastructure without reliance on the hosted service.

These statements describe the project’s current intent and direction.  
They are non-binding and do not modify the legal terms of this Agreement.

- **“Project Lead”** refers to the individual designated as the lead maintainer of arkos-core, responsible for project direction, governance, and final decisions regarding Contributions.

- **“Maintainers”** refers to the Project Lead and any additional individuals designated by the Project Lead to assist with ongoing maintenance and development, as listed in the repository or associated contributor documentation.
